prompt:
The snippet snippets/predictive-search-form.liquid outputs the predictive search form together with its stylesheet and script. Several literal references point to assets, translation keys or snippets that do not exist, so Theme Check reports errors. Fix only the literal operands and keep all markup, attributes and order unchanged.

Requirements:
1. The stylesheet (asset_url | stylesheet_tag) must reference the existing file assets/component-predictive-search.css.
2. The deferred <script> src (asset_url) must reference the existing file assets/predictive-search.js.
3. Translation keys (t filter) must all exist in locales/en.default.json: the data-loading-text attribute uses the loading key under accessibility; the label, the input placeholder and the submit button aria-label use the label, placeholder and submit keys under templates.search.
4. The submit button renders the existing search icon snippet (icon-search) and the loading state renders the existing spinner snippet (loading-spinner).
5. After your fix, Theme Check must report no missing asset, missing translation key or missing snippet errors for this file. Change only snippets/predictive-search-form.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
